result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: an untranslated section heading and awkward horizontal clipping at the right edge.

issues.description: The heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing section title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the translation mapping and render the intended localized title, such as "Popular near you".

issues.description: The category row and "Fastest near you" carousel are abruptly clipped at the right edge, including a partially visible category pill and restaurant card/text.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel padding, card widths, or overflow treatment so partial items appear intentional and text is not awkwardly cut off.
